definitions.explanation: A pattern consisting of evenly spaced dots, typically of uniform size. The Japanese name literally means 'water droplet pattern,' evoking the image of round water drops.

examples.japanese: {水玉模様|みずたまもよう}のワンピースを{買|か}った。
{赤|あか}い{生地|きじ}に{白|しろ}い{水玉模様|みずたまもよう}がかわいい。
examples.english: The white polka dots on the red fabric are cute.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{水玉模様|みずたまもよう}が{大好|だいす}きで、{服|ふく}も{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}も{水玉|みずたま}ばかり{選|えら}ぶ。
examples.english: My daughter loves polka dots and always picks polka-dot clothes and stationery.

notes:
USAGE:
Often shortened to {水玉|みずたま} in casual speech: {水玉|みずたま}のスカート (polka-dot skirt). The full form {水玉模様|みずたまもよう} is used when specifying the pattern type more precisely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水玉模様|みずたまもよう}の{服|ふく} (polka-dot clothes)
- {大|おお}きな{水玉|みずたま} (large polka dots)
- {小|ちい}さな{水玉|みずたま} (small polka dots)

RELATED PATTERNS:
Other common Japanese pattern names: {縞模様|しまもよう} (stripes), {花柄|はながら} (floral pattern), チェック{柄|がら} (checkered pattern).
